title.en: Fable 14 — The Farmer and the Snake

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A farmer found a snake frozen in the snow.

sentences.ar: הוא לקח אותו ושם אותו ליד האש.
sentences.en: He took it and put it by the fire.
The snake warmed up and woke.

sentences.ar: הוא נשך את היד שעזרה לו.
sentences.en: It bit the hand that helped it.
The farmer said: I took pity on a snake.
A bad nature is not changed by warmth.
